message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote/URL fetching, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any of the input files.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized data via pickle.load() and extracts a tarball via tarfile without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity of loaded artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads and splits data but never checks class balance, validates expected label values, or detects anomalous label distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the code uses a simple validation_split without any tamper-evident controls.

No detected input sanitization: While there are file-existence checks and outlier filtering during data preparation, there is no validation of input shape, range, or schema for inference-time requests before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or other sanity bounds before returning inference results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a likelihood-ratio estimation model operating on numerical tabular data, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
